summary: Plugin specification và bộ plugin chính thức cho trình chỉnh sửa mã Cursor, cho phép mở rộng chức năng thông qua các extension được viết bằng TypeScript.
usecases: Automatic code completion and snippet insertion for programming languages via Cursor plugin.
Integration of AI services like Claude and GPT directly into the development workflow.
Management and automation of repetitive tasks within the coding environment.
ideas: Develop plugin connecting to local LLM for automatic code explanation and review.
Create plugin synchronizing settings across multiple developer devices.
Add built-in code quality analysis and improvement suggestions inside the editor.
